title: Edit Video by Chatting
subtitle: How prompt-based AI turns words into cuts, clones, and clips
intro: A tombstone says "RIP VIDEO EDITING 1985-2025" — DaVinci, iMovie, CapCut included. Now one creator got 50M+ views by cloning himself and editing just by chatting.
takeaway: Prompt-based editing trades manual control for speed, so check what the AI guessed before you publish.

sections.heading: Analogy: editing by talking, not clicking
sections.body:
Imagine telling a chef "make it shorter, remove the quiet parts" instead of cooking yourself. A prompt is just that instruction in plain words.

Prompt-based video editing means you type what you want and the AI does the cuts. That leads to why this exists at all.

sections.heading: Why does this exist? From timelines to chat
sections.body:
Traditional editing means dragging clips on a timeline. It is powerful but slow to learn.

These 13 tools exist to skip that. Text-to-video generation creates video from words, transcript-based editing lets you cut video by editing text, and AI avatar cloning makes a digital double that speaks for you.

Speed is the win, but speed has a cost, which is what can go wrong.

sections.heading: What can go wrong? When the AI guesses wrong
sections.body:
An AI video agent follows your prompt, not your intent. It can cut the wrong silence, clone your voice with weird tone, or invent footage you didn't ask for.

If you trust every auto-cut, you publish mistakes at scale. Always preview before you post.

steps.narration: You type a plain instruction like 'remove silences'.
The AI editor interprets your words.
It edits the transcript to cut the video.
It can also generate your cloned avatar to speak.
It renders the final video for you to review.

options: Typing instructions for AI to edit
Dragging clips manually on a timeline
quiz.why: The save shows editing by chatting with AI instead of timeline editing.

quiz.q: What fails first if you use auto-cuts on 100 videos without checking?
options: AI publishes wrong cuts and fake-sounding clones at scale
quiz.why: AI follows the prompt literally and can misinterpret silences, tone, or footage.

quiz.q: What is AI avatar cloning in this context?
options: Creating a digital double that can speak as you
Turning video back into text only
quiz.why: HeyGen example cloned the creator and got 50M+ views with AI René.
